name: Heartbreak Rhapsody
original_name: はぁとぶれぃく らぷそでぃー
source:
It's been two and a half years since I first met him.
Two and a half years since I started loving him endlessly.
Just being with him is enough to make me happy, but I'm going to turn 30 tomorrow.
If at all possible, I wish we could get married...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6356]Freem![/url]]
translation:
距离我第一次见到他已经过去两年半了。
自从我开始无休止地爱他以来已经两年半了。
和他在一起就足够让我开心了，但明天我就满30岁了。
如果可以的话，我希望我们能结婚……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6356]Freem![/url]]
